# [vktApiBufferTests.cpp](../../../../../modules/vulkan/api/vktApiBufferTests.cpp#L1)

## Overview

[`vktApiBufferTests.cpp`](../../../../../modules/vulkan/api/vktApiBufferTests.cpp#L1) implements the `api/buffer` subgroup registered by [`createApiTests()`](../../../../../modules/vulkan/api/vktApiTests.cpp#L102). The file tests Vulkan buffer creation and memory allocation under various usage flags, allocation strategies (suballocated vs dedicated), sparse buffer handling, large buffer sizes, and invalid buffer feature exposure for depth/stencil formats.

## Role of File

Implementation-heavy test file for the `api/buffer` subgroup.

## Test Families

### 1. Buffer creation and allocation under usage flags

The `suballocation` subgroup at [`vktApiBufferTests.cpp`](../../../../../modules/vulkan/api/vktApiBufferTests.cpp#L753) and `dedicated_alloc` subgroup at [`vktApiBufferTests.cpp`](../../../../../modules/vulkan/api/vktApiBufferTests.cpp#L759) test buffer creation and memory binding for various usage flag combinations. Cases are generated by [`createBufferUsageCases()`](../../../../../modules/vulkan/api/vktApiBufferTests.cpp#L754) which iterates over buffer usage flags, sharing modes, and sparse binding flags. Suballocation uses standard memory allocation; dedicated allocation uses `VK_KHR_dedicated_allocation`.

### 2. Large buffer size tests

The `basic` subgroup at [`vktApiBufferTests.cpp`](../../../../../modules/vulkan/api/vktApiBufferTests.cpp#L765) contains tests for large buffer sizes (excluded for Vulkan SC):

- `max_size`: creates a buffer using the `maxBufferSize` limit at [`vktApiBufferTests.cpp`](../../../../../modules/vulkan/api/vktApiBufferTests.cpp#L768)
- `max_size_sparse`: creates a sparse buffer using the `maxBufferSize` limit at [`vktApiBufferTests.cpp`](../../../../../modules/vulkan/api/vktApiBufferTests.cpp#L771)
- `size_max_uint64`: creates a buffer with `ULLONG_MAX` size and verifies it either succeeds or returns an allowed error at [`vktApiBufferTests.cpp`](../../../../../modules/vulkan/api/vktApiBufferTests.cpp#L774)

All three require `VK_KHR_maintenance4` via `checkMaintenance4Support`.

### 3. Invalid buffer feature checks for depth/stencil formats

The `invalid_buffer_features` subgroup at [`vktApiBufferTests.cpp`](../../../../../modules/vulkan/api/vktApiBufferTests.cpp#L782) iterates over all depth and stencil formats from [`formats::depthAndStencilFormats`](../../../../../modules/vulkan/api/vktApiBufferTests.cpp#L785) and verifies that drivers do not expose undesired format features for these formats when used as buffers.

| Dimension | Observed values / evidence |

| Allocation kind | `ALLOCATION_KIND_SUBALLOCATED`, `ALLOCATION_KIND_DEDICATED` in [`AllocationKind`](../../../../../modules/vulkan/api/vktApiBufferTests.cpp#L49) |

## Support / Feature Requirements

- dedicated allocation tests require `VK_KHR_dedicated_allocation` via [`DedicatedAllocationBuffersTestCase::checkSupport()`](../../../../../modules/vulkan/api/vktApiBufferTests.cpp#L177)
- sparse buffer tests require `sparseBinding`, `sparseResidencyBuffer`, and `sparseResidencyAliased` features via [`BuffersTestCase::checkSupport()`](../../../../../modules/vulkan/api/vktApiBufferTests.cpp#L136)
- large buffer size tests require `VK_KHR_maintenance4` via `checkMaintenance4Support` at [`vktApiBufferTests.cpp`](../../../../../modules/vulkan/api/vktApiBufferTests.cpp#L768)
- `basic` subgroup tests are excluded for Vulkan SC via `#ifndef CTS_USES_VULKANSC` at [`vktApiBufferTests.cpp`](../../../../../modules/vulkan/api/vktApiBufferTests.cpp#L766)

## Verification Methods

- buffer creation and allocation tests verify that `vkCreateBuffer` and `vkAllocateMemory` succeed and that memory requirements are consistent with the buffer size
- [`BufferTestInstance::bufferCreateAndAllocTest()`](../../../../../modules/vulkan/api/vktApiBufferTests.cpp#L185) checks that the memory requirement size is at least as large as the requested buffer size
- large buffer tests verify that creating a buffer with `maxBufferSize` succeeds or returns an allowed error
- invalid buffer feature tests verify that depth/stencil formats do not expose buffer format features

## Test Principles Observed

- Cover both suballocated and dedicated allocation strategies
- Test boundary conditions like maximum buffer sizes and `ULLONG_MAX`
- Verify that drivers do not expose invalid format features for depth/stencil formats
- Require appropriate feature/extension support before testing sparse or dedicated allocation

## Notes / Uncertainties

- The exact set of usage flag combinations generated by `createBufferUsageCases` is not visible in the inspected excerpt; the function is called at [`vktApiBufferTests.cpp`](../../../../../modules/vulkan/api/vktApiBufferTests.cpp#L754) but its implementation was not fully read.
- The `LargeBufferParameters` struct and `testLargeBuffer` function used by the `basic` subgroup are not visible in the inspected range.
